prompts.a-rotor-loop: Logo mark design for 'Re::Source', premium aerospace supply-chain software that re-sources replacement jet-engine parts. Flat vector logo, centred on a pure near-black charcoal (#0B0B10) background, generous padding, no text unless stated, no mockup, no shadows, no 3D render, crisp geometric shapes suitable for SVG tracing and favicon use. Colour: a single smooth thermal gradient running from cool intake cyan (#38BDF8) through electric violet (#8B5CF6) and magenta (#EC4899) to hot exhaust amber (#FB923C). Concept: a circular turbine rotor seen head-on, made of 8 swept crescent blades that together read as a continuous circular 'renew' loop; the hub is two small stacked dots like a double colon '::'.
